Sonraki kesin ayrışma bu açılışı sıradan bir besmele olmaktan çıkarır; merhamet, sınırı yumuşatan değil zorlamasız ve kin tutmayan biçimde kuran çerçeve olur. {س م و B005; ء ل ه B002; ر ح م B001; ر ح م B002; ر ح م B003}

parent_channels.name: Sovereignty, Service, and Reversed Allegiance

subchannels.name: Crowned Voice and Honored Ruler
subchannels.scene_or_process: A titled ruler is crowned, speaks with social force, and receives honor and service.
subchannels.active_motifs: effective local ruler (`ق و ل:B004/m01`); titled woman (`ق و ل:B004/m02`); crown (`ك ف ر:B015/m01`); coronation (`ك ف ر:B015/m02`); honored or served superior (`ع ب د:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The ruler motif supplies the speaking office, coronation marks that office visibly, and the honored superior completes the hierarchy through received service. The feminine title preserves the same ranked social role with a different bearer.

subchannels.name: Bowed Service and Devotional Allegiance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Worship is enacted as directed service, with bodily lowering expressing the worshipper's chosen allegiance.
subchannels.active_motifs: devotional worship (`ع ب د:B003/m01`); bowed salute with lowered head or hand to chest (`ك ف ر:B014/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The repeated worship relation acquires a bodily counterpart in the bowed salute. Action and posture together form a scene of allegiance rather than a merely abstract profession.

subchannels.name: Chattel Hierarchy and Coerced Labor
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dominion reduces a person to owned status and compels work under humiliating control.
subchannels.active_motifs: chattel slave (`ع ب د:B001/m01`); saleable human property (`ع ب د:B001/m02`); making someone a slave (`ع ب د:B004/m01`); coercing slave-like labor (`ع ب د:B004/m02`); humiliating compulsion (`د ي ن:B004/m01`); dominion and ownership (`د ي ن:B004/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Ownership supplies the legal relation, enslavement supplies the transition into that relation, and coerced labor supplies its lived operation. The scene turns the vocabulary of service into a complete hierarchy of possessor, possessed person, compulsion, and work.

subchannels.name: Civic Obedience and Betrayed Benefit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A settlement organizes obedience to rulers, while ingratitude breaks the reciprocal bond between received benefit and civic loyalty.
subchannels.active_motifs: city as the seat of rule (`د ي ن:B006/m01`); civic obedience to authority (`د ي ن:B006/m02`); concealment or denial of a benefit (`ك ف ر:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The city is defined by enacted obedience rather than buildings alone. Ingratitude reverses that organizing relation by receiving a benefit while withholding its acknowledgment, turning a moral failure into a breach of polity.

subchannels.name: Coerced Reversal of Allegiance
subchannels.scene_or_process: An already obedient person is pressured away from devotion and into disobedience.
subchannels.active_motifs: obedient submission (`د ي ن:B001/m01`); submission to a worldly power (`ع ب د:B003/m02`); compelling the obedient to disobey (`ك ف ر:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene begins with an established relation of obedience. A rival power then acts on that relation, redirecting submission until obedience becomes rebellion and allegiance changes object.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Authority becomes visible through rank, service, obedience, ownership, and the power to redirect another person's allegiance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 109:1 `قُلْ` opens an authoritative address, 109:2-5 repeatedly distinguish worship acts and worshippers, and 109:6 `دِينُكُمْ` / `دِينِ` assigns each side its religious relation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The worship contrast expands into coronation, civic order, chattel status, bowed ceremony, and coerced disobedience.

parent_channels.name: Judgment, Trust, and Liability

subchannels.name: Ruling Speech and Religious Attribution
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fluent speaker advances a ruling, testimony is credited, and an authoritative declaration assigns another person a religious status.
subchannels.active_motifs: eloquent or prolific speaker (`ق و ل:B003/m01`); arrogated judgment over another (`ق و ل:B010/m01`); crediting testimony in judgment or oath (`د ي ن:B007/m01`); declaring someone an unbeliever (`ك ف ر:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Eloquence supplies the speaking participant, judicial credit supplies the procedure, and ruling speech produces an attributed status. The declaration therefore acts upon a person socially rather than merely describing an idea.

subchannels.name: Entrusted Conscience and Solicitous Stewardship
subchannels.scene_or_process: Responsibility is delegated to a person's conscience and carried out through sustained, sincere care.
subchannels.active_motifs: entrusting a person to conscience or religion (`د ي ن:B007/m02`); sincere care for a matter (`ق و ل:B015/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Delegation transfers the decision inward, while solicitude governs how the entrusted person tends the matter. Together they form a fiduciary scene of trust, conscience, and responsible attention.

subchannels.name: Reckoning Ripening Inside an Enclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A case remains contained through reckoning until its recompense emerges, as fruit develops inside a sheath.
subchannels.active_motifs: judgment and reckoning (`د ي ن:B002/m01`); recompense or repayment (`د ي ن:B002/m02`); fruit sheath or calyx (`ك ف ر:B010/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The sheath and the reckoning share a containing function: each holds a developing outcome before disclosure. Recompense corresponds to the fruit that finally emerges from the period of enclosure.

subchannels.name: Negotiated Debt Becoming Bondage
subchannels.scene_or_process: Negotiation creates a deferred financial obligation that can harden into the debtor's bonded status.
subchannels.active_motifs: negotiation over an affair (`ق و ل:B009/m01`); financial debt or loan (`د ي ن:B003/m01`); deferred transaction (`د ي ن:B003/m02`); debt-bound servant (`د ي ن:B004/m03`)
subchannels.synthesis: Speech establishes the terms, deferment creates the outstanding claim, and unpaid liability transforms a financial relation into a social condition. The movement from agreement to bondage gives obligation a concrete human outcome.

subchannels.name: Swift Expiation and Discharged Offense
subchannels.scene_or_process: An offense is covered over through expiation without prolonged delay.
subchannels.active_motifs: expiation that covers an offense (`ك ف ر:B009/m01`); brief delay (`ع ب د:B009/m01`); swift motion (`ع ب د:B009/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Expiation changes the standing of the offense by making it as though covered from the account. Brief delay and swift movement add a temporal mechanism: remediation follows the wrong without lingering.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Claims and obligations pass through speech, entrusted judgment, reckoning, and acts that create or discharge liability.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 109:1 `قُلْ` supplies the speech act, while 109:6 `دِينُكُمْ` / `دِينِ` opens the lexical movement from religious commitment to judgment, recompense, and obligation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A fruit sheath figures the interval before judgment yields its outcome, while speed figures the rapid removal of an offense.

parent_channels.name: Declaration, Belief, and Separation

subchannels.name: Public Declaration of Distinct Worship
subchannels.scene_or_process: An articulated address names its audience, repeatedly distinguishes the two worship relations, and closes by assigning each side its religion.
subchannels.active_motifs: articulated speech (`ق و ل:B001/m01`); tongue as the instrument of speech (`ق و ل:B002/m01`); denial of truth or unbelief (`ك ف ر:B003/m01`); devotional worship (`ع ب د:B003/m01`); religion or religious way (`د ي ن:B001/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Speech and tongue provide the act and instrument of declaration. The named audience, reciprocal worship clauses, and final allocation of religion convert doctrinal difference into an explicit relation between two communities.

subchannels.name: Inner, Conjectural, and Doctrinal Saying
subchannels.scene_or_process: A proposition begins inwardly, can be framed as conjecture, and can settle into a declared doctrinal position.
subchannels.active_motifs: unspoken inner proposition (`ق و ل:B012/m01`); statement functioning as conjecture (`ق و ل:B011/m01`); doctrinal belief or school (`ق و ل:B013/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The three senses trace a semantic transformation within saying: thought exists before utterance, receives a modal status as conjecture, and becomes a durable position when adopted as doctrine.

subchannels.name: Fabricated Speech as Concealed Ingratitude
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker invents or falsely attributes words in order to deny an acknowledged benefit.
subchannels.active_motifs: fabricated speech (`ق و ل:B005/m01`); false attribution to a speaker (`ق و ل:B005/m02`); ingratitude that conceals a benefit (`ك ف ر:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Fabrication supplies the false utterance, false attribution shifts responsibility for it, and ingratitude supplies the object being obscured. The result is denial performed through manipulated speech.

subchannels.name: Definition, Indication, and Disavowal Boundaries
subchannels.scene_or_process: Signs and definitions mark a conceptual limit, and disavowal turns that limit into a social separation.
subchannels.active_motifs: a thing indicating its own state (`ق و ل:B014/m01`); logical definition (`ق و ل:B016/m01`); disavowal or severed association (`ك ف ر:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Indication allows a thing to communicate without ordinary speech, while definition fixes what belongs inside a category. Disavowal applies the same boundary-making operation to affiliation, stating what and whom one no longer shares.

subchannels.name: Circulating Talk and Factional Dispersal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Doctrinal talk circulates among people as communities and their paths separate in multiple directions.
subchannels.active_motifs: circulating public talk (`ق و ل:B007/m01`); scattered groups (`ع ب د:B010/m01`); divergent roads (`ع ب د:B010/m02`); denial of truth or unbelief (`ك ف ر:B003/m01`); religion or religious way (`د ي ن:B001/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Circulating discourse carries the difference through the social field. Scattered groups and diverging roads give that difference a spatial form, with each community proceeding along its own religious course.

subchannels.name: Doctrinal Naming, Indignation, and Regret
subchannels.scene_or_process: A doctrinal attribution provokes zeal or anger and can end in grief or regret when affiliation is lost.
subchannels.active_motifs: doctrinal position (`ق و ل:B013/m01`); declaring someone an unbeliever (`ك ف ر:B006/m01`); pride, zeal, or anger (`ع ب د:B008/m01`); grief or regret at loss (`ع ب د:B008/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Naming a doctrinal position alters social standing and triggers protective zeal. When the boundary produces separation or loss, the same emotional field turns from indignation toward sorrow and regret.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech makes commitments visible, distinguishes positions, and turns doctrinal difference into social boundaries, dispersal, and emotional consequence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 109:1 `قُلْ` addresses `ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ`, 109:2-5 oppose the two sides through repeated worship clauses, and 109:6 `دِينُكُمْ` / `دِينِ` states the final separation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Spoken declaration extends into inner propositions, logical definition, nonverbal indication, circulating rumor, divergent roads, indignation, and regret.

parent_channels.name: Covering, Containment, and Transformation

subchannels.name: Obscuring Layers and Engulfing Media
subchannels.scene_or_process: A layer or surrounding medium removes an object, light source, or horizon from view.
subchannels.active_motifs: physical covering (`ك ف ر:B001/m01`); celestial obscuration (`ك ف ر:B001/m02`); enveloping darkness (`ك ف ر:B002/m01`); vast sea or river (`ك ف ر:B002/m02`); sunset or disappearance (`ك ف ر:B002/m03`)
subchannels.synthesis: Cloth, cloud, darkness, and vast water differ in material but share the same spatial operation: the surrounding layer exceeds the visible object and hides it. Sunset supplies the resulting disappearance at the horizon.

subchannels.name: Thought Held Like Fruit in Its Sheath
subchannels.scene_or_process: An inward proposition remains unexpressed as a developing fruit remains enclosed by its calyx.
subchannels.active_motifs: unspoken inner proposition (`ق و ل:B012/m01`); fruit sheath or calyx (`ك ف ر:B010/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The calyx provides a concrete container and the inward proposition provides concealed content. Both scenes preserve something formed but not yet exposed, making disclosure analogous to fruit emerging from its sheath.

subchannels.name: Covered Seed and Customary Cultivation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A cultivator repeatedly places seed beneath soil so concealment initiates growth rather than erasure.
subchannels.active_motifs: farmer covering seed with earth (`ك ف ر:B008/m01`); customary or habitual practice (`د ي ن:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Covering is the operative step of sowing, and customary practice turns that step into a recurring cycle. What disappears beneath the soil is being prepared for later emergence.

subchannels.name: Remote Places Behind Terrain and Walls
subchannels.scene_or_process: Distance and physical enclosure separate a settlement, grave, or passage from ordinary human access.
subchannels.active_motifs: remote tract (`ك ف ر:B012/m01`); isolated village (`ك ف ر:B012/m02`); grave (`ك ف ر:B012/m03`); mountain mass (`ك ف ر:B013/m02`); low boundary wall (`ك ف ر:B013/m03`)
subchannels.synthesis: Remoteness supplies social separation, while mountain and wall supply physical screening. The village and grave become two forms of set-apart place, one inhabited and one funerary.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A covering can hide, contain, protect, cultivate, or isolate according to what lies beneath it and what outcome the enclosure serves.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 109:1 `ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ` carries the concealment sense into the address, while 109:1 `قُلْ` and 109:6 `دِينُكُمْ` / `دِينِ` connect enclosure to inward thought and customary action.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same operation spans cloth over armor, cloud over sun, engulfing darkness or water, fruit calyx, buried seed, grave, mountain pass, and wall.

parent_channels.name: Routes, Carriers, and Interrupted Circulation

subchannels.name: Prepared Road Through a Sheltered Pass
subchannels.scene_or_process: A leveled, traveled road makes a concealed mountain passage usable.
subchannels.active_motifs: paved or trodden road (`ع ب د:B005/m01`); sheltered mountain pass (`ك ف ر:B013/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The pass supplies difficult terrain and the prepared road supplies the human intervention that makes traversal regular. Concealment and leveling therefore cooperate in a single route scene.

subchannels.name: Pitch-Coated Vessel in Engulfing Waters
subchannels.scene_or_process: A vessel is sealed with pitch so it can move through a vast sea or river.
subchannels.active_motifs: pitch-coated vessel (`ع ب د:B005/m03`); vast sea or river (`ك ف ر:B002/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Pitching prepares the hull as a water-resistant carrier, while the sea or great river supplies the engulfing setting. The material treatment is functional: it enables passage through the medium that surrounds the vessel.

subchannels.name: Prepared but Resistant Mount
subchannels.scene_or_process: A treated mount is readied for travel and speed but can resist handling and refuse the route.
subchannels.active_motifs: tar-treated camel (`ع ب د:B005/m02`); swift running (`ع ب د:B009/m02`); resistant or difficult camel (`ع ب د:B011/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Treatment and speed describe the intended readiness of the carrier; resistance reverses that readiness at the level of agency. The mount can be materially prepared without becoming behaviorally compliant.

subchannels.name: Speech in Transit and Carrier Breakdown
subchannels.scene_or_process: Talk circulates between people, may be pulled into one speaker's possession, and stops when its carrier fails in a remote place.
subchannels.active_motifs: circulating public talk (`ق و ل:B007/m01`); appropriating a saying to oneself (`ق و ل:B006/m01`); journey broken by an exhausted or lost mount (`ع ب د:B011/m01`); remote tract (`ك ف ر:B012/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Public talk behaves like material in transit: it moves through a network and can be diverted into private ownership. The exhausted carrier and remote setting then supply a concrete mechanism for interrupted circulation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Movement depends on prepared surfaces and carriers, then branches or stops when the route, vehicle, animal, or bearer changes state.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Paved roads and pitch-coated vessels extend into resistant mounts, failed journeys, circulating rumor, and speech drawn into private possession.

parent_channels.name: S1. Camphor and the Perfume Brazier
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Aromatic material from the camphor plant is prepared and released through a perfume brazier.
parent_channels.active_motifs: camphor fragrance (`ك ف ر:B011/m01`); camphor plant (`ك ف ر:B011/m03`); perfume brazier (`ع ب د:B012/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The plant supplies the aromatic substance and the brazier supplies the tool that heats or presents it. Together they form a compact scene of material, instrument, and released scent.

parent_channels.name: S2. Camphor-Named Spring
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A spring in the garden is identified through the camphor name.
parent_channels.synthesis: This sense shifts camphor from aromatic substance to a named water source, producing a distinct landscape scene rather than a perfumery scene.

parent_channels.name: S3. Conjecture About a Remote Settlement
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A speaker forms a supposition concerning an absent or isolated village.
parent_channels.active_motifs: statement functioning as conjecture (`ق و ل:B011/m01`); isolated village (`ك ف ر:B012/m02`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Conjectural speech supplies the uncertain cognitive act, while the remote settlement supplies an object beyond immediate inspection. Distance explains why the proposition remains supposition rather than direct report.

parent_channels.name: S4. Solidity Across Body and Material
parent_channels.scene_or_process: One quality of force and durability appears as animal vitality and as the lasting strength of cloth.
parent_channels.active_motifs: force, hardness, and durability (`ع ب د:B007/m01`); robust camel (`ع ب د:B007/m02`); strong cloth (`ع ب د:B007/m03`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Bodily robustness and textile durability share resistance to weakness, wear, or collapse. The channel is a cross-entity analogy of sustained material strength.

parent_channels.name: S5. Ball-Striking Implement
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A shaped stick serves as the tool for striking a ball in play.
parent_channels.synthesis: The motif forms a complete tool-action-object scene: the implement is defined by the impact it delivers to the ball.
